preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers within the given bounds.
n and k have the same parity (both odd or both even).

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: any(len(t) == k and all(s.find(t, i) == s.find(t) for i in range(1, len(s) - len(t) + 1) if s.find(t, i) != -1) for t in [s[i:i+k] for i in range(len(s) - k + 1)])
postconditions.description: There exists at least one substring of length k that is unique in the output string.

postconditions.expression: all(len(t) < k or any(s.find(t, i) != s.find(t) for i in range(1, len(s) - len(t) + 1) if s.find(t, i) != -1) for t in [s[i:i+l] for i in range(len(s)) for l in range(1, k)] if len(t) < k)
postconditions.description: No substring of length less than k is unique in the output string.
